items.source: Returns whether the type can be considered a collection, which means it's a container of elements, e.g. a Collection and Array or anything implementing Iterable. If this returns true you can expect getComponentType() to return a non-null value.
items.translation: 返回该类型是否可以被视为集合，即它是否为元素的容器，例如Collection和Array，或任何实现Iterable的类型。如果此方法返回 true，则可以预期getComponentType()将返回非 null 值。

items.source: Returns whether the type can be considered a collection, which means it's a container of elements, e.g. a Collection and Array or anything implementing Iterable.
items.translation: 返回该类型是否可以被视为集合，即它是否为元素的容器，例如 Collection 和 Array，或任何实现 Iterable 的类型。

items.source: Returns the component type for Collections, the key type for Maps or the single generic type if available. Throws IllegalStateException if the component value type cannot be resolved.
items.translation: 返回 Collection 的组件类型、Map 的键类型，或在可用时返回单个泛型类型。如果无法解析组件值类型，则抛出 IllegalStateException。

items.source: Returns whether the property is a Map. If this returns true you can expect getComponentType() as well as getMapValueType() to return something not null.
items.translation: 返回该属性是否为 Map。如果此方法返回 true，则可以预期 getComponentType() 以及 getMapValueType() 将返回非 null 值。

items.source: Returns if the current TypeInformation can be safely assigned to the given one. Mimics semantics of Class.isAssignableFrom(Class) but takes generics into account. Thus, it will allow to detect that a List<Long> is assignable to List<? extends Number>.
items.translation: 如果当前的TypeInformation可以安全地赋值给指定的类型，则返回 true。该方法模仿了Class.isAssignableFrom(Class)的语义，但会考虑泛型因素。因此，它可以检测到List<Long>可以赋值给List<? extends Number>。

items.source: Interface to access property types and resolving generics on the way. Starting with a ClassTypeInformation you can traverse properties using getProperty(String) to access type information.

items.source: Returns the component type for Collections, the key type for Maps or the single generic type if available.

items.source: Returns the property information for the property with the given name or throw IllegalArgumentException if the type information cannot be resolved.

items.source: Returns if the current TypeInformation can be safely assigned to the given one.

items.source: Returns the property information for the property with the given name or throw IllegalArgumentException if the type information cannot be resolved. Supports property traversal through dot notation.

items.source: Specializes the given (raw) TypeInformation using the context of the current potentially parameterized type, basically turning the given raw type into a parameterized one. Will return the given type as is if no generics are involved.
